idea-plugin.name: Slang [Unofficial] Refined
idea-plugin.description:
I didn't find any working slang lsps here, so I just took one and added a lot of features that make it work.

So this plugin gives you everything, code completion, syntax highlight, docs in popup, go-to-definition, find usages, rename, clang-format support, vcpkg-installed slang support etc

This is a refined fork of Slang [Unofficial], props to 16-Bit-Dog
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Slang Refined — supported features

  • Language support for .slang and .slangh files through Slang's language server and LSP4IJ
  • Syntax highlighting and semantic colors
  • Code completion
  • Language-server diagnostics, document symbols in the Structure view, and configurable inlay hints
  • Go to Declaration/Definition
  • Hover and Quick Documentation
  • Find Usages
  • Native usage navigation from declarations
  • Rename
  • Document, selection, and on-type formatting through clang-format
  • Automatic discovery of locally installed vcpkg slangd packages, plus an explicit server directory and PATH-based discovery
  • Project settings for additional include/search paths, predefined macros, and searching workspace subdirectories

The rename fallback covers project Slang files under the current server configuration. It cannot check inactive code, external references, or new-name conflicts. Built-in/external declarations and ambiguous or unverified targets are rejected; changes to project files during search or preview require a new search.

Requires LSP4IJ and a working slangd installation. Formatting additionally requires clang-format. Server-provided features depend on the installed Slang version.
